title: ConversationUpdate
description: Request body for PATCH /api/conversations/{id} — the editable fields on a conversation row. Per issue #48 the only editable field today is the operator-facing title; null clears the title and makes the conversation eligible for auto-title regeneration on the next opportunity.

title.description: Human-readable label shown in the sidebar and conversation header. Trimmed of surrounding whitespace by the handler. Null (or empty after trim) clears the title back to autogen-eligible state per issue #48.
